# AutoSkill Local Skill Manager, turn what you repeat into reusable skills — only with your approval

Curated by Skill Harbor: a lightweight local skill-file manager, not a skill that does a task for you. After a substantive session it runs a silent, non-blocking check for a reusable preference, rule, correction, workflow, failure fix, or quality gate. It classifies the experience, searches your local skills for a similar skill before creating anything, scores candidates by evidence, recurrence, personal value, and portability, and then shows you a complete proposed skill or a complete diff. It decides, with you, one of five outcomes: discard, keep_note, improve, merge, or create. The default goal is not a marketplace-ready generic skill; it is to preserve reusable behaviour that helps this user, this team, or this workspace in future sessions. It operates only on ordinary local skill folders and does not depend on project-specific code, servers, vector stores, databases, or storage layouts. This fiche covers ONLY the skills/autoskill SKILL.md manager from ECNU-ICALK. It does NOT install the AutoSkill SDK, Web UI, proxy, SkillEvo, or any Docker setup from the same repo.
